scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Analytic proof with branch checks and infinite-scale Carleson estimates; no numerical experiment is used as proof. Priority for the classical one-variable critical example is not claimed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limits: Only asymptotic comparability is claimed; no exact essential-norm constant is claimed. The conclusion is limited to this family and these two spaces.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proved_scope: The explicit real-parameter family has the stated compactness/boundedness trichotomy on BMOA_D and VMOA_D, via a proved logarithmic Carleson-box profile.

title: A sharp logarithmic compactness threshold for Dirichlet-series Volterra operators
